Quan Ho singers perform traditional duet-style singing, a UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage, on a boat during the Mid-Autumn Festival and the Boat Festival in northern Vietnam. The singers, usually young men and women, wear ao dai, a traditional Vietnamese dress. They perform without musical instruments, emphasizing their vocal talents and the poetic interplay that is a hallmark of Quan Ho. The boat is set on a tranquil river or lake, surrounded by lush greenery and rice paddies, creating a serene and picturesque backdrop. The scent of blooming jasmine flowers and the sound of water contribute to the immersive atmosphere, reflecting the deep cultural importance of this art form.
